given: A location has no stock records filed against it
when: The team member views that location on the stock-by-location table
then: An explicit "No stock at this location" message is shown instead of a blank page
architectural_notes: Behavior test against a zero-record branch reads via app/routes -> StockService -> StockRepository and asserts the rendered empty-state message, so E2E. Guards the never-blank-page requirement for an empty location.

independence.rationale: AC1/AC3 assert populated rows and their grain; AC4 asserts the zero-record empty state. A build could render rows correctly when data exists yet show a blank page when a location has no records, failing AC4 while AC1/AC3 stay green.
